name: Returns Desk
verb: Find the clause. Keep the context.
description: Bring the request, the policy and the unresolved question into one considered review. Start with fit-related exceptions that need a person, not another self-service form.
input: Customer return intent + versioned merchant policy
output: An evidence-linked recommendation for a named CX reviewer
boundary: Policy matches do not establish eligibility. The merchant decides.

name: Returns Review
verb: A better fit. With your approval.
description: Evaluate an alternative against size, stock and merchandising rules. A compatible recommendation is useful only when your team is prepared to stand behind it.
input: Original SKU + mock inventory + approved merchandising rules
output: A constrained shortlist for a merchandising approver
boundary: Generic exchange suggestions already exist. Incremental compatibility value must be tested.

name: Returns Proof
verb: See the evidence. Leave room for doubt.
description: Keep photos, item details and customer context beside the question they help answer. Missing evidence stays visible; it never becomes an automatic rejection.
metric: Evidence completion · review minutes · appeal rate
input: Permissioned photos + item identifiers + customer explanation
output: A source-indexed evidence packet for exception review
boundary: Evidence collection is not abuse scoring. Customers can explain or appeal.

name: Returns Signal
description: Connect the customer conversation to what the warehouse actually sees. Distinguish requested, received and inspected states before proposing a disposition.
metric: Inspection lag · disposition accuracy · handoff time
input: Consented 3PL event + inspection notes + case reference
output: A dated inspection signal and proposed disposition
boundary: No receipt is inferred from a request. No carrier labels or physical actions are generated.

name: Returns Report
verb: Let every exception teach you something.
description: Turn carefully reviewed cases into questions your catalog and quality teams can act on. A fit pattern can inform a size guide; a repeated quality concern can prompt inspection.
metric: Actioned feedback · repeat reasons · verified quality findings
input: Reviewed reason taxonomy + SKU context + inspection evidence
output: An illustrative catalog or quality review brief
boundary: Sample records are not measured performance. Correlation is not a confirmed defect.
